Displaced populations


Addressing nutrition in refugees
Owing to the nature of displacement and the loss of livelihoods, refugee populations are extremely vulnerable. Often, refugees settle
in camps with support from the international community and host government. In some cases, refugees may live in open situations
in which they integrate into the local community. In almost all cases, refugees are dependent on outside assistance, although the
level of need depends on the level of self-reliance the refugees can achieve. In some instances, refugees are able to bring some assets
